movelist.name: Wake-Up Slap
movelist.effect: If the target is Asleep, Wake-Up Slap has a Damage Base of 10 (3d8+10 / 24) instead, and cures the target of Sleep.

movelist.name: U-Turn
movelist.effect: If U-Turn successfully hits its target, the user deals damage and then immediately is returned to its Poké Ball in the same turn. A New Pokémon may immediately be sent out. Using U-Turn lets a Trapped user be recalled.

movelist.name: Echoed Voice
movelist.effect: If Echoed Voice was used by any Pokémon or Trainer in the Encounter on the previous round, increase its Damage Base by +4. If Echoed Voice was used by any Pokémon or Trainers during both the previous two rounds, increase its Damage Base by +8.

movelist.name: Acrobatics
movelist.effect: If the user is not holding an item, Acrobatics instead has a Damage Base of 11 (3d10+10 / 27).

movelist.name: Teeter Dance
movelist.effect: Teeter Dance Confuses all Legal Targets.

abilities.name: Serene Grace
abilities.effect: The user’s Effect Range is increased by +2.

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Confusion. Defensive.

abilities.name: Lullaby
abilities.effect: Connection - Sing. Whenever the user uses the Move “Sing”, they may activate this Feature. The user then picks a Pokémon or Trainer being targeted by Sing; Sing automatically hits that target.
